title: Fiscal Endpoint Resource Identifier
description: A canonical uniform resource identifier string representing a specific fiscal audit stream endpoint within the version 9 procedural entity framework. This string must strictly adhere to the defined path structure, identifying a unique entity by its ID for audit stream retrieval. The format is strictly '/api/v9/proc/entity/{entity_id}/audit_stream', where {entity_id} is a valid alphanumeric identifier, UUID, or system slug. This schema ensures that all fiscal audit operations are routed to the correct versioned processor.
